## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.

## Type of change

- [ ] New prompt card
- [ ] New skill card
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the anti-reinvention policy and governance conventions.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own card/code.
- [ ] I have commented my card/code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have run the local validation script (`python scripts/validate_cards.py`).
- [ ] New and existing tests pass locally with my changes.
